record.dic_text:
02078 Zebach {zeh'-bakh}

與 02077 同; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Zebah 12; 12

西巴 = "獻祭"
1) 米甸人的兩個王之一, 此二王發兵大舉入侵巴勒斯坦, 結果敗在基甸
的手上
record.edic_text:
02078 Zebach {zeh'-bakh}

the same as 02077;; n pr m

AV - Zebah 12; 12

Zebah = "deprived of protection"
1) one of the two kings of Midian who commanded the great invasion
   of Palestine and finally were defeated by Gideon
